name: 写作节奏分析
description: Analyzes writing cadence and rhythm patterns.
useCase: Detecting AI text through metronomic regularity
mechanism: Calculates autocorrelation of row energy to detect periodic patterns. AI text shows metronomic regularity, while human writing has natural cadence variations.
source: Tay et al. (2020) - Comparative Study of Human vs. Machine Generated Text
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Tay et al. (2020) - Comparative Study of Human vs. Machine Generated Text
Neal, T. et al. (2018). Surveying Stylometry Techniques and Applications. ACM Computing Surveys.
Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
